question:
Answer every part independently.
part_1: How many distinct companies have processes recorded as Body-in-White Assembly?
part_2: Which companies have both processes recorded as Drive Unit Assembly and services recorded as Battery Engineering?

gold_sql.part_1: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.company) AS n FROM companies c JOIN processes x ON x.row_id = c.row_id WHERE x.process = 'Body-in-White Assembly'
gold_sql.part_2: SELECT DISTINCT c.company FROM companies c JOIN processes x1 ON x1.company = c.company JOIN services x2 ON x2.company = c.company WHERE x1.process = 'Drive Unit Assembly' AND x2.service = 'Battery Engineering' ORDER BY c.company

note: Recombination of existing dev components; not an independent unseen-fact benchmark. Not used for checkpoint selection.
